# OSRMPlus

> Routing, distance matrices, and fleet optimization API.

OSRMPlus is a cloud API for road network routing. You send coordinates, you get
back routes, distance matrices, and optimized vehicle plans. It is built on OSRM
and is fully compatible with OSRM clients.

Base URL: https://api.osrmplus.com
Authentication: x-api-key header or Authorization: Bearer header

IMPORTANT: OSRM GET endpoints use lng,lat coordinates. Optimization POST
endpoints use [lat, lon] in the JSON body. These two conventions are different.

## Install

Python: pip install osrmplus
JavaScript: npm install osrmplus

## Python example

```python
from osrmplus import Client
client = Client("your_api_key")

# Route (coordinates are (lng, lat) tuples)
route = client.route([(74.3436, 31.5497), (74.2650, 31.4700)])

# Matrix (coordinates are (lng, lat) tuples)
matrix = client.matrix(coordinates=[(74.34, 31.55), (74.27, 31.47), (74.30, 31.50)])

# VRP (coordinates are [lat, lon])
result = client.vrp(
    coordinates=[[31.5497, 74.3436], [31.4700, 74.2650], [31.5000, 74.3000]],
    num_vehicles=2,
    depot=0,
    demands=[0, 3, 2],
    vehicle_capacities=[6, 6],
    time_limit_seconds=10,
)
```

## JavaScript example

```javascript
import { OSRMPlus } from "osrmplus";
const client = new OSRMPlus("your_api_key");

// Route (coordinates are [lng, lat])
const route = await client.route([[74.3436, 31.5497], [74.265, 31.47]]);

// Matrix (coordinates are [lng, lat])
const matrix = await client.matrix({ coordinates: [[74.34, 31.55], [74.27, 31.47]] });

// VRP (coordinates are [lat, lon])
const result = await client.vrp({
    coordinates: [[31.5497, 74.3436], [31.47, 74.265], [31.5, 74.3]],
    num_vehicles: 2,
    depot: 0,
    demands: [0, 3, 2],
    vehicle_capacities: [6, 6],
    time_limit_seconds: 10,
});
```

## curl example

```bash
# Route (lng,lat in the URL)
curl "https://api.osrmplus.com/route/v1/driving/74.3436,31.5497;74.2650,31.4700" \
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_KEY"

# Matrix (lng,lat in the URL)
curl "https://api.osrmplus.com/table/v1/driving/74.34,31.55;74.27,31.47;74.30,31.50" \
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_KEY"

# VRP ([lat, lon] in the JSON body)
curl -X POST "https://api.osrmplus.com/vrp" \
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"coordinates":[[31.55,74.34],[31.47,74.27],[31.50,74.30]],"num_vehicles":2,"depot":0,"demands":[0,3,2],"vehicle_capacities":[6,6],"time_limit_seconds":10}'
```

## Endpoints

GET /route/v1/driving/{lng,lat;lng,lat} - point-to-point route
GET /table/v1/driving/{coords} - distance and duration matrix
GET /nearest/v1/driving/{lng,lat} - snap coordinate to nearest road
GET /match/v1/driving/{coords} - match GPS traces to roads
GET /trip/v1/driving/{coords} - fastest round trip
POST /vrp - multi-vehicle fleet optimization
POST /tsp - shortest tour (single vehicle)
POST /optimize - VRP with sensible defaults

## Route response shape

{ "code": "Ok", "routes": [{ "distance": 12453.2, "duration": 847.3, "geometry": "...", "legs": [...] }] }

## Matrix response shape

{ "code": "Ok", "durations": [[0, 234.5], [234.5, 0]], "distances": [[0, 3200], [3200, 0]] }

## VRP request shape

{ "coordinates": [[lat,lon], ...], "num_vehicles": 2, "depot": 0, "demands": [0, 3, 2], "vehicle_capacities": [6, 6], "time_limit_seconds": 10 }

Key VRP fields: coordinates, distance_matrix, num_vehicles, depot, vehicle_starts, vehicle_ends, demands, vehicle_capacities, vehicle_max_distances, vehicle_max_times, time_windows, service_times, time_limit_seconds, objective (minimize_total_distance|minimize_longest_route|minimize_total_time|minimize_vehicles_used), strategy, allow_dropping_visits, drop_penalty, detailed_solution, use_guided_local_search, use_tabu_search, use_simulated_annealing.

## VRP response shape

{ "job_id": "abc", "status": "ROUTING_SUCCESS", "routes": [{ "vehicle_id": 0, "route": [0, 2, 1, 0], "distance": 4210, "load": 5 }], "total_distance": 8300, "dropped_nodes": [], "statistics": { "vehicles_used": 2, "num_locations": 4, "solve_time_ms": 1820 } }

Always check the status field. An infeasible problem returns 200 with status "NO_SOLUTION_FOUND".

## Error codes

401 api_key_required - no key sent
401 api_key_invalid - key not recognized
403 region_not_licensed - coordinates outside your regions
402 quota_exceeded - monthly limit reached
429 rate_limit_exceeded - too many requests per second

Sign up at https://osrmplus.com (free, no credit card)
Docs at https://osrmplus.com/docs
Playground at https://osrmplus.com/playground
